journey.name: The log
journey.description: Plan a workout from the first run, end a workout after its first round, find it in Log and open it, then clear the log. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: On "Set up", which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip for now"
Verify that the screen shows "Train to a plan"
Verify that the screen shows "Weekly goal" and a "Routine" row for each weekday
Verify that the weekly goal shows 3
Tap the "Train" tab, tap "Conditioning", then tap "Timer" at the top of the presets
Verify that a dialog titled "End workout?" says "1 of 8 rounds done"
Verify that the summary shows "Ended" and "Saved to your log"
Tap "Back" on the Timer, which returns to Conditioning, then tap the "Log" tab

Verify that "Week" is picked, "This week" reads "2 more to hit 3" with a 1/3 ring, a "Conditioning" bar reads "1 of 1", and "Done this week" heads one card whose row is marked "Today" and reads "Conditioning · 30s on · 15s off · ×8 · ended early" with the time
Tap the workout on the "Today" row
Verify that its page shows "ended early", "Repeat now" and "Plan again"
Verify that a calendar of this month shows today marked done
Verify that a dialog titled "Clear the log?" is shown
Verify that the screen is back to "Train to a plan": with no workouts and nothing planned, Log starts over
